metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/ replays the recorded Sharpa Wave episode on the Marvin arms in both modes (553 rows; success after 453 controls): two fresh-process replays with identical state hashes, float32 rows succeed. No Wuji reference solution.

notes.layout: Each row starts with the 14 Marvin arm joint targets (left arm J1-J7, then right arm J1-J7), followed by the left hand's finger targets and then the right hand's (22 per hand for `sharpa`, 20 per hand for `wuji`). The robot stands at the world origin facing +x; at the start the left arm is parked and the right hand is palm up beside the book; both arms may be used.
